scripts.prepare-game: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('www/icons',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','icon.svg','manifest.webmanifest'])fs.copyFileSync('../'+f,'www/'+f);fs.mkdirSync('www/fonts',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../fonts'))fs.copyFileSync('../fonts/'+f,'www/fonts/'+f);for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../icons'))fs.copyFileSync('../icons/'+f,'www/icons/'+f)"
scripts.android: npm run prepare-game && npx cap add android; npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run prepare-game && npx cap add ios; npx cap sync ios
